_doc: Q6162 trade atoms: how each trade's pieces are laid out when the documents don't say. Every value carries its source; values the documents give (wall type layers, submittals, specification sections) win over these, and a project overrides any of them with project rules (custom/trade:<section>.<key>, stud_layout/<wall type or general>, joist_layout/general). Waste values are factors: they never change a piece count, only the bim.trades totals 'with waste'.

framing.stud_spacing_source: company default: 16" o.c. where the wall type gives no spacing
framing.steel_gauge_source: company default: 20 ga studs where the wall type names no gauge
framing.steel_stud_short_source: company default: studs cut 1/2" short of the track-to-track height
framing.plates_source: IRC R602.3.2 / company default: wood walls a single bottom plate and a double top plate; steel walls a top and a bottom track
framing.jamb_source: company default: one king (jamb) stud each side of an opening, one jack stud under a wood header
framing.header_source: company default: a header bears 3" (wood) or laps 6" (steel track header) each side of its opening
framing.wood_header_source: company default after IRC Table R602.7(1): built-up header by opening width (ft); wider than 8' is engineered
framing.fire_block_source: IBC 718.2.2: fireblocking in concealed wood stud spaces at 10' intervals

backing.source: company default: TV backing 48" wide behind the TV outlet
ADA 609 / company default: backing behind grab bars at 33" to 36" AFF
company default: backing behind a wall-hung lavatory
company default: a backing strip along the top and bottom of wall-hung casework
company default: backing behind a toilet accessory

framing.joist_spacing_source: company default: 16" o.c. where the documents give no joist spacing
framing.truss_spacing_source: company default: 24" o.c. where the truss documents give no spacing
framing.joist_depth_source: company default: 11 7/8" I-joist where the documents give no depth

drywall.sheet_source: trade stock: 4' wide sheets, 8', 9', 10' and 12' long
drywall.orientation_source: company default: sheets hung vertically (parallel to the studs), as most fire-rated designs require
drywall.screws_source: company default: about one screw per square foot of board (12" o.c. in the field and 8" at the edges on studs 16" o.c.)
drywall.compound_source: company default: about 140 lb of ready-mixed joint compound per 1,000 sf finished (Level 4)
drywall.finish_source: company default: GA-214 Level 4 where the documents give no finish level
drywall.waste_source: company default: 10% board waste (a factor, not pieces)

insulation.r_source: company default: the batt that fills a cavity of that depth (fiberglass, kraft or unfaced)

masonry.unit_source: trade stock: 8x8x16 nominal concrete masonry units (1.125 per sf)

concrete.slab_on_grade_source: company default: 4" slab on grade where the documents give no thickness
concrete.pt_slab_source: company default: 5" post-tensioned slab where the documents give no thickness
concrete.tendon_spacing_source: company default: tendons 5' o.c. each way where the PT layout read gives no spacing (a ribbed slab's beams are its own)
concrete.strand_weight_source: ASTM A416: 1/2" strand 0.52 lb/ft, 0.6" strand 0.74 lb/ft
concrete.tendon_edge_source: PTI DC10.5 / company default: tendons start 12" in from the slab edge
concrete.chair_source: company default: chairs 4'-0" o.c. under tendons and bar mats
concrete.mesh_sheet_source: trade stock: welded wire sheets 8' x 20'
concrete.mesh_lap_source: ACI 318 25.5.3 / company default: sheets lapped one mesh spacing plus 2"
concrete.mesh_weight_source: WRI common styles: weight per 100 sf
concrete.vapor_barrier_source: ACI 302.1R / ASTM E1745: 10 mil minimum under a slab on grade

finishes.paint_coats_source: company default: a primer and one finish coat where the documents give no coats
finishes.base_source: company default: 4" base where the finish schedule gives no height
finishes.act_tile_source: company default: 2x2 tiles where the ceiling plan gives no grid
finishes.grid_source: ASTM C635 / company default: main runners 4' o.c., cross tees between, wall angle round the room

firestopping.source: IBC 714 / ASTM E814: every penetration of a fire-rated wall or floor is firestopped with a listed system

openings.frame_source: company default: a hollow metal frame in a steel stud or masonry wall, a wood frame in a wood stud wall, unless the door hardware schedule names it

specialties.scope_source: the submittal's title names the rooms its accessories go in: guest rooms are the rooms of a unit type, public toilets the rooms named as toilets
